```sql
WITH springfield_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Springfield' AND border_type = 'city'
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM springfield_geom), TRUE),
      1,
      '32BF'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM springfield_geom))
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS mean_slope_degrees
FROM (
  SELECT
    (ST_SummaryStats(slope_rast, TRUE)).mean AS value
  FROM slope_raster
) sub;
```
